entries.source_title: Model completeness for the differential field of transseries with exponentiation
entries.source_excerpt: We show that the expansion of the valued differential field of logarithmic-exponential transseries by its natural exponential function is model complete. We give an axiomatization of the theory of this expansion that is effective relative to the theory of the real exponential field, and show that any maximal Hardy field satisfies the same axioms. We use this to prove a transfer theorem between Hardy fields and transseries.
entries.title_zh: 含指数函数的 transseries 微分域模型完备性
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明带自然指数函数的对数—指数 transseries 有序微分域扩张是模型完备的，并给出相对于实指数域理论可有效公理化的理论。作者进一步证明任意极大 Hardy 域满足同一组公理，从而建立 Hardy 域与 transseries 之间的迁移定理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合模型论、渐近分析与微分代数读者，关注形式级数结构与函数域之间的逻辑联系。

entries.title_zh: FineEnvs/openai-math：用于 Harbor 的 Lean 数学证明环境数据集
entries.summary_zh: 该数据集把 OpenAI 的 openai/math 数学问题移植为 Harbor 环境，369 个任务的官方证明已在所述环境中由 oracle 端到端验证；原发布中的 405 条 Lean 陈述有 36 条未纳入，原因包括依赖缺失、内存不足或验证未完成。任务要求智能体在 Lean 4 与预构建 Mathlib 沙箱中补全证明，并由独立沙箱中的 Lean 内核检查精确陈述。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对研究 Lean 定理证明智能体、基准构造或奖励判定的人有直接价值，尤其值得关注其严格验证规则和未纳入任务的记录；运行成本和判分限制也应纳入实验设计。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于 Harbor 智能体的定理证明实验，但每个任务需要较多计算资源，且需配置 Daytona 与模型凭据。
entries.cynic_review: 严格匹配原陈述让判分更明确，却会把等价表述、部分进展和有缺口的策略一律记为零，限制了它作为开放式数学研究信号的代表性。
entries.paper_review: 材料给出任务数、验证规则、官方证明的 oracle 结果及失败分类，证据较具体，但本摘录仍不是对数据集或其证明的独立复核。

project_insight.translation_zh: 这是将 OpenAI 发布的 openai/math 问题移植为 Harbor 环境的数据集。发布说明称，原发布将 405 个结果形式化为 Lean 陈述；本数据集包含其中 369 个环境，其官方证明已在相应环境中端到端验证，覆盖 17 个领域的 214 个结果族。任务要求智能体在无网络的 Lean 4 与预构建 Mathlib 沙箱中补全缺失证明，随后由新的沙箱检查证明是否对应完全相同的原陈述、没有遗留 sorry 或新增公理，并被 Lean 内核接受。项目标注 Apache-2.0，并另列 openai/math 的许可与归属文件。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一组用于 Harbor 的 Lean 4 定理证明任务，以精确陈述匹配和 Lean 内核检查作为成功判据。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读数据集的 Validation 与严格奖励说明，挑选少量任务确认 Lean 陈述、依赖和 oracle 状态；按页面要求准备 Harbor 0.24+、Daytona 后端及智能体凭据，并预留约 9 GB 的共享沙箱镜像构建资源和每题所列资源。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 页面明确标注该数据集为实验性，底层研究发布也尚未独立审阅，并建议依赖评分为 1 的证明前先阅读证明。369 个任务之外还有 36 条陈述未验证；任务需 Daytona、智能体凭据、每题 4 CPU/8 GB 内存/10 GB 磁盘且最长 4 小时，页面报告已接受证明的中位验证耗时为 8 分钟。判分要求完全证明原始精确陈述，不奖励等价改写或部分进展。
use_cases_zh: 比较不同代码智能体或模型完成 Lean 4 数学证明任务的能力。
研究形式化证明基准如何设计可复核的奖励与防作弊验证。
用已验证任务测试 Lean 工具链、Mathlib 环境或智能体解题流程。

entries.source_title: Schnorr Randomness and Effective Bayesian Consistency and Inconsistency
entries.source_excerpt: We study Doob's Consistency Theorem and Freedman's Inconsistency Theorem from the vantage point of computable probability and algorithmic randomness. We show that the Schnorr random elements of the parameter space are computably consistent, when there is a map from the sample space to the parameter space satisfying many of the same properties as limiting relative frequencies. We show that the generic inconsistency in Freedman's Theorem is effectively comeager, which implies the existence of computable parameters which are not computably consistent. Taken together, this work provides a computability-theoretic solution to Diaconis and Freedman's problem of ``know[ing] for which [parameters] the rule [Bayes' rule] is consistent'', and it strengthens recent similar results of Takahashi on Martin-L\"of randomness in Cantor space.
entries.title_zh: Schnorr 随机性与有效贝叶斯一致/不一致
entries.summary_zh: 论文在可计算概率与算法随机性框架中研究 Doob 一致性定理和 Freedman 不一致性定理。若样本到参数的映射满足类似极限相对频率的条件，参数空间中的 Schnorr 随机点可保证可计算一致性；同时 Freedman 定理中的典型不一致集合被证明为有效 comeager，从而存在不可计算一致性的可计算参数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合算法随机性、统计学基础及可计算贝叶斯推断研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把随机性等级与贝叶斯一致性条件联系起来，并给出存在性结论。
entries.cynic_review: 假设依赖特定可计算映射和概率结构，尚非一般贝叶斯保证。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确区分一致与不一致结果，形式定义和与 Martin-Löf 结果的关系需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: The transition between order to disorder in the Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson model
entries.source_excerpt: We study the Sepp\"al\"ainen-Johansson model of first-passage percolation along a region of the plane where it moves from an ordered to a disordered phase, represented by a 2nd order discontinuity in its limit shape function. The fluctuations in this transition region are of order one, and we determine that certain limiting statistics are described by Fredholm determinants and are closely related to the largest eigenvalue of the GUE.

entries.source_title: Sample, Mix, or Verify? Allocating Test-Time Compute under Imperfect Verifiers
entries.source_excerpt: A common way to make language models and agents more accurate is to spend more compute at inference time: generate many candidate solutions and submit the one a verifier prefers. Success then requires that some candidate is correct and that the verifier picks it. The first grows predictably with the number of samples; the second does not, because real verifiers (unit tests, majority votes, LLM judges, reward models) accept wrong answers, reject right ones, and make correlated mistakes. With a fixed budget, a practitioner must decide how many samples to draw, which models to draw them from, and how much to spend on verification, and today these choices are made by rules of thumb. We introduce SPLIT, which makes them from a small labelled pilot. It rests on an exact formula for the probability of submitting a correct answer under accept/reject and top-score selection that accounts for varying task difficulty, blind spots shared across models, and correlated repeated verifier calls. SPLIT fits the formula by empirical Bayes and uses it to plan budgets on unseen tasks. Across seven benchmarks spanning math, science QA, code and software-e

entries.source_title: Density Bounds in Hua's Theorem for Prime Squares
entries.source_excerpt: We prove a density version of Hua's theorem in the five-variable case: if $\mathcal P$ is a subset of the primes with relative lower density greater than $0.82$, then every sufficiently large $n\equiv5\pmod{24}$ is a sum of five squares of primes from $\mathcal P$.

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合解析数论读者关注加法表示在高密度删选下的稳健性，以及五变量和同余条件的作用。

entries.source_title: Spectral asymmetry and odd cycles in integral graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the triangle $C_3$ is the only integral unicyclic graph with an odd cycle. The main tool is a spectral inequality that does not require integrality: if $G$ is a connected non-bipartite graph and $G-e$ is bipartite for some edge $e$, then the eigenvalues $\lambda_1\ge\cdots\ge\lambda_n$ of $G$ satisfy $\sum_{i}(\lambda_i+\lambda_{n+1-i})^+\le 2$ and $0<\lambda_1+\lambda_n\le 1$. It follows from comparing $A(G)$ with the signed adjacency matrix obtained by reversing the sign of $e$, which is similar to $-A(G)$, through a common rank-one perturbation and Weyl's monotonicity theorem. For integral graphs in this class, an arithmetic lemma then gives $\lambda_n=1-\lambda_1$ and at least $\lambda_1-1\ge1$ triangles, which yields the classification. entries.source_title: Unconditional Bounds for Two, Three and Four Consecutive Moderate Gaps between Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function
entries.source_excerpt: We prove unconditional positive-proportion results for consecutive moderate gaps between zeros of the Riemann zeta function. More precisely, for every fixed \(00\). The proof combines Lamzouri's Hilbert-space formulation of the Montgomery--Taylor second-moment method with local spectral estimates for simple critical-line zeros and a cluster-counting argument that accounts for multiple zeros and zeros off the critical line.

entries.source_title: Singular vectors of sparse random rectangular matrices: Transition between delocalized and semilocalized phases
entries.source_excerpt: Consider the bipartite Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi graph $\mathbb{G}(n,m,d/\sqrt{mn})$ at the critical sparsity $d = b\log(N)$ for some $b > 0$ with $N = n + m$, and constant aspect ratio $\gamma = n/m \geq 1$. We show that the spectrum of its centered and rescaled bi-adjacency matrix, whose limiting law is the Mar\v{c}enko--Pastur (MP) distribution, is split into two phases: in the bulk, singular vectors are completely delocalized, while near the edges, singular vectors are semilocalized, with their mass concentrating on small disjoint balls, centered at vertices with extreme degrees. As $b$ decreases, we identify sharp thresholds for the emergence of outlier singular values. For explicit $b_{\rm R}^{\star}$ and $b_{\rm L}^{\star}$ as functions of $\gamma$, we prove that when $b > b_{\rm R}^{\star}$, there is no outlier outside the bulk; when $b_{\rm L}^{\star}< b < b_{\rm R}^{\star}$, only right outliers emerge; and when $b < b_{\rm L}^{\star}$, outliers are present on both sides, all with high probability. entries.source_title: Generating functions of hypermaps and m-constellations with two alternating boundaries
entries.source_excerpt: We study the enumeration of planar hypermaps with several alternating boundaries. We first derive a peeling recursion with an arbitrary number of alternating boundaries and, in the two- boundary case, translate it into a functional equation for the corresponding generating function. Our main result is an explicit solution of this equation for m-constellations. In particular, we obtain a rational expression for the genus-zero two-point function, or cylinder generating function, with two alternating boundaries.

entries.summary_zh: 论文对可和相互作用的零场 Ising 模型证明总自旋经方差标准化后满足 Berry–Esseen 界，Kolmogorov 距离为 C_{β,J}|Λ|⁻¹/²，适用于任意固定亚临界 β；周期化格点模型的相应速率为 L⁻ᵈ/²。经典最近邻模型还可覆盖 −βc<β<βc 的铁磁与反铁磁区间，作者同时得到相同速率的 1-Wasserstein 界，并将结论延伸到相应无限体积自由边界 Gibbs 测度。

entries.pragmatic_review: 显式样本量收敛速率让中心极限定理近似可定量使用。
entries.cynic_review: 速率常数依赖 β 与相互作用，临界点本身不在结论内。
entries.paper_review: 摘要陈述两种概率距离及边界条件范围，常数与证明细节需全文确认。

entries.source_title: Vector bundles on singular surfaces and threefolds
entries.source_excerpt: We fully classify vector bundles of critical rank on normal affine surfaces and threefolds over algebraically closed fields via their Chern classes. We also prove existence of rank $2$ bundles on threefolds with prescribed first and second motivic Chern classes. The main input is the motivic filtration on algebraic $K$-theory: its third piece is generated by smooth closed points and is identified with motivic cohomology by the third Chern class.
entries.title_zh: 奇异曲面与三维簇上的向量丛
entries.summary_zh: 论文通过 Chern 类完整分类代数闭域上正规仿射曲面和三维簇的临界秩向量丛，并证明三维簇上存在具有指定第一、第二 motivic Chern 类的秩二向量丛。关键工具是代数 K 理论的 motivic 过滤：其第三层由光滑闭点生成，并通过第三 Chern 类与 motivic 上同调识别。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数几何读者关注 Chern 类何时足以分类低秩向量丛，以及 K 理论过滤的构造作用。
entries.pragmatic_review: 分类与存在性结果为仿射簇上的丛构造提供明确判据。
entries.cynic_review: 结论限定在正规仿射低维簇和临界秩条件。
entries.paper_review: 摘要指出核心过滤层与 Chern 类识别，具体维数和秩条件需核对全文。

entries.source_title: A generalised and modular proof-theoretic semantics for sequent systems
entries.source_excerpt: Base-extension semantics explains logical consequence via derivability in atomic systems. Extending this approach across logics requires careful control of structural principles and contexts. We present a modular sequent-based framework in which support is indexed by multisets of atomic resources and the semantic clauses for connectives are guided by their left introduction rules. The framework separates additive from multiplicative behaviour and makes explicit the contributions of structural rules and restrictions on sequents. We establish soundness and completeness for classical and intuitionistic propositional logic and for multiplicative-additive fragments of classical and intuitionistic linear logic. We then investigate axiomatic extensions of intuitionistic logic through Jankov logic. Two classes of atomic bases yield sound and complete semantics. Completeness is proven using two novel and modular methods using simulation bases, one of which is constructive. entries.title_zh: 序列演算系统的广义模块化证明论语义

entries.source_title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 1: The Case \(n+\log n\)
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha(n+\log n))_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for Lebesgue almost every real $\alpha$. This solves a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 2, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021].
entries.title_zh: 度量 Poisson 配对相关性（一）：α(n+log n) 序列
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，对 Lebesgue 几乎所有实数 α，序列 (α(n+log n)) 具有 Poissonian pair correlation，并解决 Aistleitner、El-Baz 与 Munsch 在 2021 年提出的第二个开放问题。此处“几乎所有”排除了一个测度为零的参数集合，结论不是对每个固定 α 的逐点保证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注数论序列的局部间距统计与参数几乎处处性质的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 简洁的非线性序列给出了检验配对相关猜想的一类明确模型。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要未说明证明工具，且度量结论不覆盖所有 α。
entries.paper_review: 摘要报告精确的几乎处处结论和所解问题，技术贡献需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Where Latents Belong and How They Flow: Joint Identification of Structural Roles
entries.source_excerpt: Latent factors in dynamical systems can play different roles across observations and time. For example, an idea in a group meeting may be expressed by only some participants, inherit information from earlier discussions, and shape what is said next. We formalize this notion as the structural role of a latent factor, describing where it is expressed, whether it receives influence from the past, and whether it transmits influence to the future. The main challenge is correspondence, since the three structures may be identified under different permutations, while a structural role is defined only when they are aligned to the same latent coordinate. We show that, under suitable structural and variability conditions, all three roles are jointly identifiable under a common permutation at each time point. Guided by this theory, we develop RoleTrace, a framework that traces structural roles in a shared latent coordinate system. Synthetic experiments validate structural recovery, while experiments on multiparty meetings examine the identified roles in real sequential interactions.
entries.title_zh: 潜变量的位置与流动：结构角色的联合识别
entries.summary_zh: 论文把动态系统中的潜因子结构角色定义为其在哪些观测表达、是否受过去影响、是否影响未来，并处理三种结构识别时潜变量坐标置换不一致的问题。作者证明在合适结构与可变性条件下，三种角色可在每个时间点以同一置换联合识别，并提出 RoleTrace；合成数据测试结构恢复，多人会议序列用于展示应用。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合时序表示学习及社会交互分析读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 明确讨论潜变量对应这一常被忽略的识别难点。
entries.cynic_review: 理论条件是否满足真实会议数据需进一步验证。
entries.paper_review: 给出可识别性结论和实证场景，假设与基准比较需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Multilevel Gaussian Processes with Applications to Inverse Problems
entries.source_excerpt: We present a multilevel Gaussian process (GP) regression framework for approximating functions that are accessible only through a hierarchy of approximations of increasing accuracy and computational cost. One example is the response surface of a parametrized partial differential equation, where the hierarchy arises from the resolution of the numerical solver. Modeling level increments independently with Mat\'ern-kernel GPs and allocating samples flexibly across discretization levels yields substantial computational savings over single-level GP regression. We derive $L^2$ convergence rates for the posterior mean and variance, accounting for maximum likelihood estimation of the marginal variance and for kernel misspecification. When increment regularity or solver cost is unknown a priori, an adaptive sequential-design algorithm with cost-adapted active learning criteria allocates samples across levels. We apply the surrogate to Bayesian inverse problems, for which Hellinger distance bounds between the true and approximate posteriors are known. Numerical experiments illustrate the theoretical rates and the resulting computational savings
entries.title_zh: 多层高斯过程及其逆问题应用
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出多层高斯过程回归，把不同精度、成本的近似层级建模为独立增量，并灵活分配样本；对参数化 PDE 响应面可利用不同网格分辨率降低成本。作者推导后验均值与方差的 L² 收敛率，考虑边际方差极大似然估计及核错设，并给出成本自适应主动学习；在贝叶斯逆问题中利用 Hellinger 距离控制近似后验误差。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合科学计算与贝叶斯反问题读者评估多精度代理模型。
entries.pragmatic_review: 同时连接收敛理论、主动采样和后验近似误差。
entries.cynic_review: 效率优势取决于层级增量规律与求解成本，需实际校验。
entries.paper_review: 理论和应用链条完整，最优分配条件及实验规模需读全文。

entries.source_title: Computing S(X) for Ruled Surfaces Defined by Stable Bundles on Curves of Genus 2
entries.source_excerpt: This paper discusses the algebra of symmetric tensors for ruled surfaces defined by rank 2 stable vector bundles on curves of genus 2. The algebra is computed for special bundles $E$ when $S^2 E$ is destabilized by a line bundle and when $S^3 E$ is destabilized by a bundle of rank 2. A strategy for computation is discussed in regards to the other special bundles $E$. This paper also discusses the generalization of these strategies to higher genus and gives a computation when $E$ is not stable and may be written as a direct sum of line bundles.
entries.title_zh: 亏格二曲线上稳定丛定义的 ruled surface 对称张量代数
entries.summary_zh: 论文计算由亏格二曲线上的秩二稳定向量丛 E 定义的 ruled surface 对称张量代数 S(X)，重点处理 S²E 被线丛 destabilize，以及 S³E 被秩二向量丛 destabilize 的特殊情形。作者讨论其他特殊稳定丛的计算策略，并将思路推广到更高亏格；对 E 非稳定且可写成线丛直和的情形也给出计算。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数几何读者研究向量丛稳定性如何影响 ruled surface 的对称张量代数结构。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对称代数计算可为研究特殊向量丛构造提供案例。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要只覆盖若干 destabilization 模式，不能视为完整分类。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明所处理的特殊情形与推广方向，具体代数呈现需读正文。

entries.source_title: Mathematics in the Dark Forest
entries.source_excerpt: An open problem list is a bullseye painted on your field.
entries.title_zh: 数学的“暗森林”：公开问题清单也可能成为 AI 的靶标
entries.summary_zh: Dave Anderson 以代数组合学公开问题清单为例，描述自己把三个问题交给 LLM 自主尝试：模型很快声称解决其中两个，但作者尚未仔细检查或用 Lean 形式化验证，因此特意把“解决”加上引号。文章借此讨论公开问题如何成为模型的明确目标、未经核验的解答如何影响声誉和研究激励；它呈现的是一次探索性实验和作者对学术机制的担忧，不证明模型已经可靠解决这些问题。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合了解 AI 数学实验如何从开放问题列表启动，也提醒读者区分模型产出的候选证明与经同行审查的定理。
entries.pragmatic_review: 问题清单可用于定向探索，但每个结果都需要数学家独立核验。
entries.cynic_review: 作者尚未验证两份解答，标题中的“解决”不能当作已证事实。
entries.paper_review: 文章公开了问题选择和提示方式，但没有给出形式验证或完整复现实验。

entries.source_title: Stability and Error Estimates for Convolution Quadrature under Radial Symbol Bounds
entries.source_excerpt: We develop stability and error estimates for multistep convolution quadrature (CQ) under general radial bounds on the Laplace symbol. Instead of the classical single-power condition $|F(z)|\leq M|z|^{-\mu}$, we assume $|F(z)|\leq C\Phi(|z|)$ and consider two classes of radial functions: monotone bounds satisfying a scaling condition and regularly varying bounds with locally bounded above and away from zero. For strongly $A(\alpha)$-stable multistep methods, we derive approximation and stability estimates for the CQ weights, as well as error bounds for power-type inputs $g_\beta(t)=t^{\beta-1}/\Gamma(\beta)$ with $\beta>0$. These estimates explicitly retain the dependence on the memory law through the factor $\Phi(t_n^{-1})$. The framework accommodates symbols whose behavior cannot be described by a global single-power. It also preserves slowly varying and multiscale factors that would be lost under a coarser power majorant. The theory is applied to fractional viscoelastic models, distributed-order operators, and logarithmic-power memory operators. Numerical experiments with backward Euler and second-order backward differentiation CQ c
entries.title_zh: 径向符号界下卷积求积的稳定性与误差估计
entries.summary_zh: 论文将卷积求积分析从单一幂次 Laplace 符号界推广到径向函数 Φ 的界，覆盖满足缩放条件的单调函数及局部有界的正则变化函数。对强 A(α) 稳定多步法，作者推导求积权重和幂函数输入的稳定、误差估计，保留 Φ(t_n^{-1}) 对记忆核的依赖，并应用于分数阶黏弹性、分布阶和对数幂记忆算子。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合分数阶方程数值分析者处理非单幂次或多尺度记忆律。
entries.pragmatic_review: 推广常见假设且保留慢变因子的误差信息。
entries.cynic_review: 结论建立在特定稳定性与径向函数条件之上，使用时需核实假设。
entries.paper_review: 覆盖范围和应用列举清楚，精确正则性条件及收敛阶需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Proof Perplexity: A Probabilistic Approach to Measuring non-triviality in Machine Generated Proofs
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we propose a benchmark to quantify the non-triviality and novelty of machine-generated mathematical proofs compared to existing literature. Our core methodology uses a probabilistic measure to evaluate the non-triviality of the underlying mathematical arguments in comparison to the current \texttt{MATHLIB} library. Finally, we apply this benchmark to the recent proof generated by Claude on the complex zeros of the Riemann zeta function to test for non-trivial steps.
entries.title_zh: Proof Perplexity：衡量机器生成证明非平凡性的概率方法
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出一种基准，尝试比较机器生成的数学证明与现有文献及 Mathlib 库，量化论证步骤的非平凡性与新颖程度；核心是用概率度量评估底层数学论证，而不只数形式化代码长度。作者把方法用于 Claude 关于黎曼 ζ 函数复零点的近期证明，以识别可能的非平凡步骤；这是新提出的评价指标，能否可靠区分重述、组合与真正新颖论证仍需验证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注 AI 数学成果评价的人，尝试把“证明是否新”从主观判断推进到可比较指标。
entries.pragmatic_review: 与 Mathlib 比对可能帮助快速定位候选新论证。
entries.cynic_review: 概率非平凡性指标不等同于数学重要性或证明正确性。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明了基准目标和案例，但指标校准及误判率需读实验部分。

entries.source_title: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Efficient LLM Tree Search
entries.source_excerpt: Tree search enhances multi-step reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet prevailing methods expand every step with a fixed budget, irrespective of the marginal utility of expansion. We first show, across existing search algorithms, that continuations sampled from a shared intermediate state are largely duplicates and collapse to a few distinct answers. Critically, we find that the semantic dispersion of sibling actions predicts the redundancy of their downstream continuations, permitting a subtree's budget to be fixed before expansion. An information-theoretic analysis motivates this: treating the per-step budget as the Monte Carlo sample size for estimating a step's residual answer entropy, we derive a sufficient budget that shrinks with sibling dispersion. We accordingly propose $\textbf{Uncertainty-Aware Allocation}$ (UAA), a training-free framework that decouples value from uncertainty: values determine which candidates are promising, while uncertainty, estimated from sibling dispersion at no additional model cost, determines how many merit expansion, via uncertainty-aware pruning and uncertainty-aware budgeting. entries.title_zh: 面向 LLM 树搜索的认知不确定性感知预算分配
entries.summary_zh: 论文发现同一中间状态采样出的后续常高度重复，并指出兄弟动作的语义离散度可预测子树冗余。由信息论分析推导所需采样预算随离散度下降，提出免训练 UAA：价值分数选出有希望的候选，不确定性估计决定分配多少扩展计算。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合推理时搜索与 agent 计算预算优化研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 以无需额外模型成本的分散度信号调整搜索宽度。
entries.cynic_review: 语义离散度作为不确定性代理可能在任务分布变化时失准。
entries.paper_review: 方法核心清晰，完整基准收益和预算敏感性需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: ai
entries.source_excerpt: AI SDK by Vercel - build apps like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more with a single interface for any model using the Vercel AI Gateway or go direct to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or any other model provider.
entries.title_zh: Vercel AI SDK
entries.summary_zh: Vercel AI SDK 是面向 TypeScript 的模型提供方无关工具包，用于在多种 Web 框架和 Node.js 中构建 AI 应用与智能体，支持文本生成、结构化输出、工具循环智能体及聊天界面集成。材料展示了统一提供方接口和示例，也说明可经 Vercel AI Gateway 或直接连接各模型提供方。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合用 TypeScript 快速构建个人研究工具或模型交互原型；统一接口、结构化输出和工具调用示例便于连接不同模型并实现简单智能体。
entries.pragmatic_review: 若已有 Node.js 与 TypeScript 环境，可从单模型文本生成示例开始，再扩展到结构化输出和工具调用。
entries.cynic_review: 统一接口降低了接入差异，但网关路径可能引入额外服务依赖，直接连接各提供方仍需处理各自的凭据与能力差异。
entries.paper_review: 摘录提供文档、API 参考和代码示例，没有论文或系统性评测材料可供学术审查。

project_insight.translation_zh: AI SDK 是 Vercel 提供的、与模型提供方无关的 TypeScript 工具包，可用于借助常见 UI 框架和 Node.js 构建 AI 应用与智能体。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 用统一的 TypeScript 接口调用多家模型，并组合文本生成、结构化输出、工具和聊天界面。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先确认本机满足文档列出的 Node.js 22+ 要求，阅读官方安装与提供方文档；选择网关或直接提供方连接方式，从简单文本生成示例开始，并妥善管理 API 凭据。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 材料所述安装方式需要 Node.js 22+；使用模型还需相应提供方或网关访问权限，具体费用与可用性取决于服务选择。摘录没有提供安全审计或性能比较结果。
use_cases_zh: 制作个人文献整理或数学问答网页原型，并为模型响应定义结构化格式。
为研究脚本或个人知识库搭建带工具调用的轻量智能体界面。
在不同模型提供方之间切换，比较同一任务的输出和成本。

As we considered which values we wanted the journal to uphold, we realized that there may be many other values worth exploring as a community, potentially through the creation of additional journals. entries.title_zh: 创办一份新期刊
entries.summary_zh: Shaoming Guo 与几位数学同行正在筹备一份新期刊，并借此征求数学界对未来出版模式的意见。筹办者提出两项核心价值：重视论文对结果与证明的理解贡献，而非优先发表首个证明；要求投稿证明通过 Lean 形式化验证。这些是期刊规划中的提案，尚非已实施的出版规则。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 文章具体说明了拟议期刊如何评价数学贡献及处理证明可靠性，也邀请读者思考形式化验证和出版要求可能带来的取舍。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对考虑投稿或参与数学出版讨论的人有参考价值，但期刊仍在筹备，实际流程尚未明确。
entries.cynic_review: Lean 验证被视为应对 LLM 证明错误的保障，但材料没有讨论形式化工作的成本、覆盖范围或如何处理验证要求可能造成的作者负担。
entries.paper_review: 这是一篇期刊理念征询文，材料没有提供具体论文、Lean 代码、证明或可复现验证结果。

entries.source_title: fishaudio/drama-3
entries.source_excerpt: safetensors · fish_omni · fish-audio · text-to-speech · multi-speaker · audio-editing · emotional-speech-generation · zh · en · ja · ko · es · pt · ar · ru · fr
entries.title_zh: Fish Audio Drama 3：多角色长文本语音模型
entries.summary_zh: Fish Audio 将 Drama 3 描述为面向多角色场景和长内容的新一代文本转语音模型，支持多说话人生成、声音克隆、自然语言控制、分块流式输出和最长 16 个角色标签。模型卡列出在 H200 上的流式性能数据，并提供 SGLang-Omni 与 vLLM-Omni 部署示例；这些性能数字是作者报告的测试结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 对研究中文及多语种语音生成、角色对话合成或语音编辑的人，模型卡提供了架构线索、部署入口和测试条件，便于判断是否值得进一步阅读技术报告或评估部署需求。
entries.pragmatic_review: 模型卡给出了 SGLang-Omni 和 vLLM-Omni 的部署方向及流式调用示例，但 35B 参数规模和 H200 测试条件使其对普通个人设备的实用性不明。
entries.cynic_review: 材料报告了较低首音延迟和高并发吞吐，但测试使用特定 H200 配置、英语提示及给定采样参数，不能直接外推到中文或个人硬件。
entries.paper_review: 模型卡链接了技术报告并公开了部分性能测试条件和表格，但摘录没有论文正文、代码审查或独立复现证据，许可全文条款也未展示。

project_insight.translation_zh: Fish Audio Drama 3 是面向多角色场景和长篇内容的新一代文本转语音模型，支持多说话人生成、声音克隆和自然语言控制。模型采用 35B 参数、每个 token 激活 3B 参数的 MoE 文本骨干网络，结合完整注意力与线性注意力；音频解码器使用 Codebook-MTP。它支持最多 16 个说话人标签、自动长文本分块和逐块流式输出。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 一个面向多角色与长文本的语音生成模型，可按说话人标签合成语音，并支持流式输出与基于前序结果的编辑。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读模型卡链接的技术报告和许可文件，再查看 SGLang-Omni 或 vLLM-Omni 的对应部署配方；结合模型规模、硬件要求和参考音频使用条件，评估是否适合自己的环境。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 这是模型权重项目，不应视为开源软件。模型卡标注 Fish Audio Community License，但摘录未展示具体条款；性能数字来自 NVIDIA H200 上的特定测试配置，不能视为个人硬件或所有语言上的保证。声音克隆示例使用参考音频，实际使用应确认拥有相应声音和音频的授权。
use_cases_zh: 为多角色音频剧或长篇对话原型生成不同角色的语音。
评估中文及多语种文本转语音、情绪语音生成和声音克隆工作流。
研究流式语音服务的吞吐与首音延迟，并比较不同 vocoder 部署位置。

entries.source_title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents

entries.title_zh: 报道：黑客用 AI 代理攻击逾百网站，受害者包括多家企业
entries.summary_zh: The Verge 援引安全公司 Norforge 称，一名攻击者通过开源 AI 平台 Cairn 编排代理，入侵了 100 多个网站，代理承担了大部分操作；The Verge 另援引 Reuters 指出 John Deere、SharkNinja、Cummins 等公司可能在受害者之列。报道基于 Norforge 的发现与媒体转述，未在所给材料中列出完整受害清单或独立取证细节，说明的是代理可能扩大攻击自动化，而非证明代理能脱离人类独立策划入侵。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合安全团队关注代理自动化对攻击规模和防御监测的影响，同时留意事件证据来源。
entries.pragmatic_review: 应把自动化代理的高频探测纳入网站日志与速率限制设计。
entries.cynic_review: 受害者信息经多层转述，完整攻击链和归因仍需核实。
entries.paper_review: 目前是安全公司调查与新闻报道，未见完整技术报告或独立复现。

entries.source_title: GR-OPD: Group-Relative Sequence Credit for On-Policy Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We introduce \method{} (Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation), which decouples feedback computation from credit assignment by aggregating token feedback into calibrated sequence-level credit. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. It preserves relative response preferences while retaining a controlled fraction of the group mean, which we term collective teacher pressure. Across five Qwen3 teacher--student settings and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms vanilla OPD in macro Avg@K in every setting, including gains of

entries.source_title: Sharp asymptotics for the Lov\'asz number of random circulant graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We study the LOV\'ASZ number of dense random circulant graphs generated by independent Bernoulli bits indexed by cyclic distances. Although only $O(n)$ independent random inputs determine $O(n^2)$ globally dependent edge indicators, we prove sharp expectation asymptotics along all odd orders, including composite orders, with leading constant one. This resolves a conjecture posed for random circulant graphs in 2025. The proof combines an exact Fourier reduction and complementary duality with a positive interior smoothing that reveals a nonlinear random fixed-point equation. To analyze this equation under the strong dependence of the distance-bit model, we construct canonical tree fields, establish growing-degree Gaussian approximations through polynomial comparison and Wick/Hermite expansions, and transfer the resulting approximation back to the original sign model. A deterministic residual estimate together with an explicit exceptional-event integration yields the sharp expectation asymptotics.

entries.source_title: Geometric multigrid preconditioners for unfitted discretisations of the de Rham complex
entries.source_excerpt: We propose two families of multigrid preconditioners for unfitted finite element discretisations of the Riesz maps of the de Rham complex, in H(grad), H(curl) and H(div), stabilised by cell aggregation. The first is a geometric multigrid method applied directly to the unfitted operators, on a hierarchy of background meshes that share the same boundary representation. Its smoothers are star patches built on the aggregated mesh, so that each patch captures the kernel of the stabilisation. The second is a multilevel auxiliary-space preconditioner that combines a patch smoother localised around the cut cells with the body-fitted problem on the active mesh, which is in turn solved by a non-nested geometric multigrid method. Both are used as building blocks of block-diagonal preconditioners for the mixed Hodge Laplacians. Numerical experiments in two and three dimensions, on geometries with a controlled cut fraction and on general geometries, show iteration counts that are robust with respect to the cut configuration, the mesh size and the number of levels. entries.source_title: The square achievement game on $n \times n$ boards
entries.source_excerpt: Two players alternately claim cells of an $n \times n$ grid; the first to hold all four corners of an axis-parallel square wins, and a full board without one is a draw. The first player has a winning strategy if and only if $n \ge 5$, which answers a question of Erickson. For $n \ge 6$ one strategy serves every board: a rule with no lookup table whose moves after the second reply are all forcing, built around the plus, a stone with the four cells at a common distance from it along the axes, a shape proposed for this game by Sirgedas in 2010. The rule is checked on the boards of size $6$ to $17$, and a simulation theorem carries one checked run on the $23 \times 23$ board to every larger board. The proofs are formalized in Lean 4, and the theorem for the rule states that the tree of its own moves is winning.

entries.source_title: Pearl-Chat: Engineering a native Luganda language model from first principles in JAX and Flax NNX
entries.source_excerpt: Autoregressive foundation language models predominantly target high-resource Indo-European languages, imposing computational and morphological penalties on under-represented African languages. Generic multilingual tokenizers routinely exceed fertility rates of 3.2 tokens per word on agglutinative Bantu languages, degrading context efficiency and inflating latency. We present Pearl-Chat, an 8,473,122-parameter ($\sim$8.5M) causal decoder-only transformer engineered for Luganda (Oluganda, ISO 639-2: lg), a low-resource Niger-Congo Bantu language spoken by over 10 million people in East Africa. Built from first mathematical principles in JAX and Flax NNX, Pearl-Chat uses explicit functional state decomposition (nnx.split and nnx.merge), deterministic resumable data streaming via Google Grain, and SPMD tensor parallelism using jax.sharding.Mesh. We introduce a byte-level byte-pair encoding (BPE) subword tokenizer trained from scratch on curated Luganda corpora ($V = 8,192$), achieving 4.88 characters per token compression and 1.60 tokens per word fertility, a two-fold compression improvement over LLaMA-3 (128K) and Gemma (256K). The model

entries.source_title: Quadratic mixing for the Lee--Sidford Dikin walk
entries.source_excerpt: Let $K=\{x\in\R^d:Ax\ge b\}$ be a bounded full-dimensional polytope with $m$ inequalities. For targets on $K$ with density proportional to $\exp(-\vartheta^\transpose x)$, we prove a $\widetilde O(d^2)$ bound, measured in Markov chain iterations, for the chi-square mixing of the $1/2$-lazy Metropolis Dikin walk based on a polylogarithmically rescaled Lee--Sidford metric. The estimate holds for every initial law with finite chi-square divergence. The proof controls the reverse Gaussian proposal through a quantitative average self-concordance estimate at the required $O(1/d)$ scale. We establish this estimate from uniform analytic derivative bounds for the Lewis-weight subspace and an all-order projection-weighted contraction inequality for Gaussian chaoses. For order $j$, the latter bounds each base-point polynomial at scale $d^{j/2}$, up to $j$-dependent and logarithmic factors. Truncating at logarithmic order then absorbs the remaining pathwise loss. entries.title_zh: Lee–Sidford Dikin 随机游走的二次混合时间界
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究有界满维多面体上的 Lee–Sidford 度量 Dikin 随机游走，证明半惰性 Metropolis 链对目标密度 exp(−θᵀx) 的卡方混合时间为 Õ(d²) 次迭代，适用于任意具有有限初始卡方散度的分布。核心技术是以定量平均自协调性控制反向高斯提议，并结合 Lewis 权重导数界与高斯混沌的全阶投影收缩不等式；作者称这解决了此前 rigorously established 最好为 Õ(d^(9/4)) 的开放问题，摘要同时注明证明由 ChatGPT 5.6 Pro 找到，数学结论仍应按论文证明审查。

entries.source_title: The Schubert bialgebra
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce a Schubert bialgebra $\mathcal{A}=\bigoplus_{n\geq 0}\mathbb{Z}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, in which polynomials in different numbers of variables multiply to zero and the coproduct splits the variables into two consecutive blocks, and study its graded dual $\mathcal{D}$, whose product is concatenation of weak compositions. The Schubert polynomials $\mathfrak{S}_u^n$ form a basis of $\mathcal{A}$; we give an explicit formula for the dual Schubert basis $\Xi_u^n$ of $\mathcal{D}$ via a transition formula to an elementary symmetric basis, and show that the Schubert structure constants $c_{u,v}^w$ are the coefficients of the coproduct of $\mathcal{D}$ in the dual Schubert basis. The product of $\mathcal{D}$ is then lifted to an associative product $\sqcup$ on the free abelian group $\mathcal{BRC}$ of bounded RC graphs, built from a transition map $\mathcal{Z}$ on RC graphs that realizes the Lascoux-Sch\"utzenberger transition formula and generalizes Little's bumping algorithm. Quotienting $\mathcal{BRC}$ by ideals coming from Demazure crystal equivalence, Nadeau-Tewari forest equivalence, and quasi-Yamanouchi equivalence yields manife

entries.summary_zh: 论文构造由不同变量数多项式组成的 Schubert 双代数及其分次对偶，给出对偶 Schubert 基的显式公式，并把 Schubert 结构常数表示为对偶代数余乘积的系数。作者再把对偶乘法提升到有界 RC 图的自由阿贝尔群上，利用实现 Lascoux–Schützenberger 转移公式的图转移映射，经过若干等价关系商化后得到 dual Schubert、key、forest 和 slide 基的显式正 Littlewood–Richardson 规则；在 Schubert 情形对应 GL_p×GL_q 嵌入 GL_{p+q} 的分支系数。

entries.source_title: Low-weight compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ and the extended Torelli morphism
entries.source_excerpt: We study the weight zero and weight two graded pieces of the compactly supported cohomology of the moduli space $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ of stable $n$-pointed curves of genus $g$ of compact type and show that they are computed by bridgeless graph complexes. In weight two, we construct a natural embedding of shifted weight zero cohomology from lower genus. For unmarked curves, we construct canonical classes represented by pinched odd wheel graphs and prove that distinct wheel monomials give linearly independent classes in the dual of $W_0H_c^{2g}(\mathcal M_g^{ct};\mathbb Q)$. By relating the bridgeless graph complex to the $K$-theory of graphs and the Quillen spectral sequence, we show that these classes remain linearly independent after pushforward along the extended Torelli morphism $\mathcal M_g^{ct}\to\mathcal A_g$. Finally, we prove that the realizations of the motivic Lie algebra arising from $\mathcal M_g$ and $\mathcal A_g$ have the same image in the weight zero compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_g^{ct}$.

entries.source_title: Models of Arbitrary Sets
entries.source_excerpt: There is a growing literature on arbitrary objects as other types of mathematical objects, besides particular mathematical objects. In this paper we study arbitrary sets in the context of ZFC set theory. An arbitrary object is one that is determined by a state space across which it varies and by its instantiations. We compare two semantic strategies. First, we analyse the possibility of modeling arbitrary sets using direct powers of a ZFC structure. This yields a natural setting, but one where Extensionality and, crucially, the full Separation scheme fail. Second, we consider structures composed of arbitrary sets using a direct power construction evaluated in a Boolean-valued semantics. Within this setting, we develop the cumulative hierarchy of arbitrary sets, arbitrary ordinals, cardinals, and filtrations of the structure of arbitrary sets. The final section develops a combinatorial interpretation in terms of independent assignments across a fixed state space. Its connection with the iterative conception is then discussed.

entries.source_title: The Navier-Stokes Announcement: A case study in mathematical values
entries.source_excerpt: On September 8, 2026, OpenAI announced a resolution of the Navier-Stokes problem. I had expected to feel excitement if a solution was announced. Instead, my reaction was one of grief and revulsion. entries.source_title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 2: The Case \(n\log n\)
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha n\log n)_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for almost every real $\alpha$, solving a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 3, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021]. Our main contribution is a new four-point counting estimate with a fixed power saving over $N^{7/3}$ at tolerance $N^{-1}$, valid on the ranges left after a first-moment and Borel--Cantelli argument. Its proof reduces the counting condition to the required proximity of an implicitly defined real root to an integer; a Fej\'er kernel majorizes this condition, and multidimensional van der Corput $A$- and $B$-processes supply the saving. A localized Mellin argument then yields the second-moment estimate needed for the metric conclusion.
entries.title_zh: 度量 Poisson 配对相关性（二）：αn log n 序列

entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究均匀分布与数论序列局部统计的读者，展示四点计数如何导出几乎处处的配对相关结论。

entries.source_title: Galois Groups of Trinomials with Small Coefficients
entries.source_excerpt: We calculate the Galois group of $f = x^n + ax^k + b \in \mathbb{Z}\left[ x \right]$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ for all $1 \leq \left| ab \right| \leq 3$, $n$ sufficiently large and $k$ coprime to $n$. In particular, we prove that the Galois group of $f$ is the maximal one that its factorization type allows. We do it by proving a new sufficient condition for the Galois group of a factor of a trinomial to be symmetric, which perhaps can be used to derive stronger results of this kind in the future.

entries.source_title: Quasi-Monte Carlo based meshfree methods for parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds
entries.source_excerpt: We develop and analyze a randomized path sampling framework for the pointwise approximation of linear parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds, treating both closed manifolds and manifolds with Dirichlet boundary. Based on the Feynman-Kac representation, we construct a parameter-coordinate retraction-based discretization, referred to as the p-Ret scheme, for the manifold diffusion generated by the uniformly elliptic operator, and use it to formulate the Monte Carlo (MC) and randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) methods. We derive the local weak consistency of the p-Ret transition and first-order weak convergence of the temporal discretization on closed manifolds. For fixed $h$, we show that RQMC sampling yields asymptotically faster variance decay than standard MC. On closed manifolds, the variance is $o(n^{-1})$ and, under additional regularity, satisfies the sharper bound $O(n^{-2+\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$. entries.source_title: Classification of bipartite observables I: stable and uniformly stable observables
entries.source_excerpt: When two quantum systems are prepared independently and each is driven to an idealized limit, the expectation of a bipartite observable may depend on which system is idealized first. We call an observable stable when it does not. We show that stability is equivalent to two operational properties. First, every idealized preparation of one system can be simulated to arbitrary accuracy, uniformly over all probes, by finite mixtures of actual preparations, provided that the probing system is idealized first. Second, any two idealized preparations have a unique, symmetric independent product. Under a uniform form of stability, we prove, the number of preparations that $n$ adaptive probes can tell apart at a fixed margin is bounded by a polynomial in $n$, and responses can be learned with a bounded number of mistakes; otherwise, at some margin, protocols with $n$ probes tell apart $2^n$ preparations. The swap test, Hong--Ou--Mandel coincidences and discrete equality tests turn out to be uniformly stable, with bounds independent of the dimension, while order comparisons of discrete spectra unbounded above are unstable. entries.title_zh: 二部观测量分类 I：稳定与一致稳定观测量
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究两个量子系统分别取理想化极限时，二部观测量的期望值是否依赖先理想化哪一方，并把这种次序无关性定义为稳定性。作者证明稳定性等价于两项操作性质：理想制备可由有限实际制备的混合一致近似，且任意两个理想制备有唯一、对称的独立乘积；一致稳定时，n 次自适应探测能区分的制备数在固定误差下至多多项式增长，否则某个误差尺度下可达 2^n。交换测试、Hong–Ou–Mandel 计数及离散相等测试被证明一致稳定，而无界离散谱的顺序比较不稳定。

entries.source_title: Four colours are needed for closed-neighbourhood conflict-free colouring of all planar graphs
entries.source_excerpt: A colouring of the vertices of a graph is conflict-free with respect to closed neighbourhoods if every closed neighbourhood contains a colour that appears on exactly one of its vertices. The colouring need not be proper. Every planar graph has such a colouring with four colours. Fabrici, Lu\v{z}ar, Rindo\v{s}ov\'a and Sot\'ak conjectured that three colours always suffice. We disprove this conjecture. We give a simple gadget construction that turns every planar graph of chromatic number four into a planar graph with no such colouring with three colours. This also shows that it is NP-complete to decide whether three colours suffice for a planar graph. We also give a planar graph on $25$ vertices that needs four colours. Further, we give critical planar graphs on $25$ vertices with $52$ and with $51$ edges, an infinite family of plane triangulations that need four colours, and an infinite family of critical examples.

entries.source_title: $R$-trivial Galois cohomology classes and cohomological $p$-dimension
entries.source_excerpt: Given a prime $p$, a field $F$ of characteristic different from $p$ and a finite $p$-primary Galois module $V$, a Galois cohomology class in $H^n(F,V)$ is called $R$-trivial if it can be connected to $0$ by a class defined over an open subscheme of the projective line. All classes of $H^n(F,V)$ are $R$-trivial if $F$ has cohomological $p$-dimension at most $n$, by the Bloch-Kato conjecture. We show that this bound is sharp: working over fields of iterated Laurent series, we produce, for every $n\geq 1$, a field $F$ of cohomological $p$-dimension $n+1$ and a Galois module $V$ such that $H^n(F,V)$ contains classes which are not $R$-trivial. The module $V$ is a quotient of the permutation module on the affine hyperplanes of an elementary abelian $p$-group, arising as a quotient of the absolute Galois group of $F$. We also describe $R$-trivial classes as sums of corestrictions of cup products involving a Kummer class.

entries.source_title: The geometric exceptional set for Fano threefolds
entries.source_excerpt: We study the geometric exceptional set in Manin's conjecture for smooth Fano threefolds. We prove that every adjoint rigid surface with $a$-invariant one on a non-product smooth Fano threefold is normal. This yields a description of the geometric exceptional set in terms of the higher-$a$ locus, anticanonical conics, and del Pezzo fibrations. Zariski density arise only from the latter two contributions. For del Pezzo fibrations, we construct a finite collection of parameter covers which controlling the associated breaking maps. We classify their low-genus components for general smooth Fano threefolds yielding examples with potentially Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets in $22$ of the $105$ deformation families. Extending Batyrev-Tschinkel's example, we construct Fano fourfolds with quartic del Pezzo fibrations and an explicit Fano threefold with two degree-six del Pezzo fibrations, all with Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets. For this threefold, the original form of Manin's conjecture fails on every non-empty open subset for every anticanonical height.

entries.source_title: Think More or Read More? A Token-Budget Theory of Reasoning with Shared Context
entries.source_excerpt: Reasoning systems increasingly improve answers by incorporating additional context into the model's input, from multi-agent debate, where agents read their peers' responses, to self-refinement, where a model revisits its own drafts. In these systems, communication consumes context as one agent's output becomes another's input. We study the regime where token reading and generation draw on one fixed token window, so every token spent reading is a token that cannot be spent reasoning. We develop a \textbf{token-budget theory} that formalizes this trade-off, modeling accuracy as a function of the reasoning budget remaining after reading and aggregating votes with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors. For multi-agent debate, the theory gives a closed-form prediction for the optimal number of agents. This quantity is estimated from single-agent measurements, allowing the optimal group size to be determined without running debate, and the same accounting extends to a heterogeneous set of different models. entries.source_title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
entries.source_excerpt: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. **Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification. Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system. It provides multi-level rewards to support more effective agentic RL with the workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm. U

entries.source_title: Generic vanishing for Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We study generic vanishing for the Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules, where the differentials in the Dolbeault complex are modified by a one-form. We prove that, on the Dolbeault moduli space of Higgs line bundles, the cohomology support loci of mixed Hodge modules agree with the images of the cohomology support loci of their underlying $\mathscr{D}$-modules on the de Rham moduli space under the map induced by the nonabelian Hodge correspondence. We further apply this result to study Fourier-Mukai transforms of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties. We show that the extended Fourier-Mukai transform for bounded complexes of mixed Hodge modules has cohomology sheaves that are flat over the twistor line of $\lambda$-connections. This also gives an extension of Fourier transform of mixed Hodge modules to a compactification of the de Rham moduli space.

entries.source_title: A Non-Split Motohashi Formula for Toric Periods over Number Fields
entries.source_excerpt: We establish a non-split Motohashi formula for toric Eisenstein periods over an arbitrary number field $F$. For a quadratic extension $E/F$, we compare toric Fourier inversion for a product of two Eisenstein series with the $\mathrm{GL}_2/F$-spectral expansion of its Rankin--Selberg kernel. The kernel regularizes the product in a cone of absolute convergence. Eisenstein corrections and contour residues give the geometric and residual terms in the meromorphically continued identity. Suitable test data give twisted first- and second-moment formulas for the completed $L$-functions of everywhere unramified toric characters. Over general $F$ these provide an adelic counterpart of the moment formulas of Duke--Friedlander--Iwaniec that does not use the geometry of Heegner points. In the CM case, we prove the absolute nonvanishing proportion $4.9\times10^{-4}$ for every totally real base field and all sufficiently large CM discriminants, with the threshold depending on the base field and no restriction on the number of ramified primes. entries.title_zh: 数域上的非分裂 Motohashi 环积分公式
entries.summary_zh: 论文对任意数域 F 建立非分裂的 Motohashi 公式：针对二次扩张 E/F，把两个 Eisenstein 级数乘积的环 Fourier 反演与 GL₂/F 的 Rankin–Selberg 核谱展开联系起来，并用 Eisenstein 修正项和留数处理亚纯延拓。由此得到处处非分歧环特征的完备 L 函数扭曲一阶、二阶矩公式；在 CM 情形，对每个全实基域及充分大的 CM 判别式，证明绝对非消失比例至少 4.9×10⁻⁴，阈值依赖基域且不限制分歧素数个数。

entries.source_title: Anisotropic Representation Dynamics in Transformers
entries.source_excerpt: Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations. Yet it remains unclear when changes in attention weights can turn a representation difference that would otherwise shrink into one that grows. We develop a \textbf{Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics} that separates self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating. Our analysis reveals how the geometry of attended representations constrains gating and how interactions between these mechanisms can reverse contraction induced by value transport. We formalize this phenomenon as gating-induced regime switching, where a representation difference contracts under fixed attention routing but expands under full attention. We derive a necessary and sufficient spectral criterion that certifies the existence or absence of switching and identifies switching directions without exhaustive search. entries.source_title: Bengali Hallucination Detection with Retrieval and Programs: A System Study
entries.source_excerpt: Bengali hallucination detection must distinguish unsupported factual claims from incorrect reasoning, often without a supplied reference passage. We present and characterize an inference-only system that combines response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and task-specific language-model judging. Six retrieval routes search question-answer and passage collections; a router directs each example to a 27B textual judge or a 14B agent that can compare retrieved answers, reason directly, or generate and execute Python. We characterize the system using version-specific code, saved predictions, execution traces, and corpus metadata from the Olikbochon challenge. Kaggle associates a displayed private macro-F1 of 0.956 with Version 2; its saved run processes 2,516 examples in 220.99 minutes on two T4 GPUs. Of 253 math-routed examples, 88 terminate through candidate matching, while execution traces expose 49 stderr-bearing run events across 35 examples. entries.source_title: Identify, Classify, Act: Per-Instruction Controlled Compliance for LLMs over External Data
entries.source_excerpt: LLMs over external data face a per-instruction tension: a single document or tool return often interleaves legitimate directives with adversarial prompt injections, and the model must follow the former while rejecting the latter. Existing defenses suppress or trust all external instructions, collapsing the safety-utility frontier and forcing a choice between over-refusal and over-compliance. We argue the missing capability is \textbf{per-instruction credit attribution} and formalize it as External-Data Instruction Classification, an identify-classify-act decision over each embedded directive. We propose \textbf{EDIC}, a decomposed reward framework for per-instruction compliance. A scene-grounded pipeline injects mixed beneficial and harmful instructions with counterfactual filtering, while a generative judge is initialized by SFT and refined with GRPO to attribute compliance at the instruction level. The judge then produces a reward that separately encourages beneficial compliance and penalizes harmful compliance for RL training. entries.source_title: A configurational numerical viscosity for thermodynamically compatible finite volume schemes of compressible multiphase flows
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the fluid subsystem of a variationally derived hyperbolic thermodynamically compatible (HTC) model of compressible multiphase flows. Its total energy is in general not convex in the natural state variables, so a scalar numerical viscosity acting on them need not produce non-negative entropy. Reformulating the equations in terms of the volume fractions separates changes in the amount of each phase from changes in its intrinsic state. This guides the construction of a configurational numerical viscosity in phase variables, in which the energy is convex, while the scheme retains the structure of the HTC model. At the semi-discrete level, the new schemes satisfy: I) local conservation of the phase masses, the mixture momentum and the total energy; II) a cell entropy inequality whose production is non-negative face by face and phase by phase, with no convexity assumption in the evolved variables and no clipping; III) positivity of the partial densities and volume fractions under explicit time-step conditions; IV) exact preservation of contact equilibria; V) equivalence with a scheme for the density-weighted volume fractions. entries.source_title: Volterra-Skorokhod Reflection and Fluid Limits of Loss Queues
entries.source_excerpt: In the $G_t/G/n/n$ loss queue, a customer blocked at time $u$ remains missing from the system for as long as it would have been served. A fraction $K(t-u)$ of the blocking at $u$ therefore still affects the occupancy at time $t$, where $K=1-G$ is the service survival function. We show that, for every arrival process satisfying a functional strong law of large numbers, the fluid limit of this queue is a reflection with kernel $K$ of the fluid limit of the associated infinite-server queue. The reflection is defined by a one-sided reflection problem on $(-\infty,1]$ in which the regulator is convolved with a memory kernel. We refer to this problem as the Volterra-Skorokhod problem. We show existence and uniqueness of the solution and that the solution map is Lipschitz continuous in the uniform norm and nonanticipating. entries.title_zh: 损失队列流体极限的 Volterra–Skorokhod 反射
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 G_t/G/n/n 损失队列：时刻 u 被阻塞的顾客会在其原本可能服务的时间内持续影响后续占用，影响权重由服务生存函数 K(t−u) 给出。作者定义带记忆核的 Volterra–Skorokhod 单边反射，证明在适当 càdlàg 输入与 K(0)=1 下解存在唯一、解映射 Lipschitz 且非预见，从而把满足函数强大数定律的到达过程流体极限连接到相应无限服务队列；该映射不同于经典 Skorokhod 映射，通常不单调，但非增核情形下调节项具有最小性和单调性。

entries.source_title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement II: Does RLVR Need Long Rollout Windows?
entries.source_excerpt: Long rollout windows make reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) expensive, yet simply shortening them can remove the correctness signal: when every single-problem rollout truncates before an answer, group-relative accuracy advantages vanish. As a technical continuation of Batched Contextual Reinforcement (BCR), we study how concurrent rewards relax this dependence on long windows. Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR) places three independently verifiable problems in one capped training completion. Correct answers completed before truncation retain credit, while a shared budget encourages shorter useful reasoning without an explicit length penalty. We connect this mechanism to conditional reward- and update-variance analyses and study 4B and 8B mathematical reasoning models. Against single-problem GRPO with a 32k window, CCR with an 8,000-token window reduces tokens per training step from 975,464 to 174,957 on 4B and from 793,832 to 165,788 on 8B, saving 82.1% and 79.1%, respectively. entries.source_title: Nondimensionalization, Variational Inequalities and Uncertainty Quantification in a Morphoelastic Model for Burn Injury Healing
entries.source_excerpt: Mathematical modelling of burn injury healing involves coupling biological processes with mechanical deformation, resulting in computationally stiff, nonlinear partial differential equations that severely limit the scalability of existing numerical solutions. We present a computational framework addressing these challenges. By nondimensionalizing the model and performing scaling analysis, we show that chemotaxis and inertia are negligible, permitting a quasi-static momentum approach. To enforce non-negativity constraints, we implement a Variational Inequality formulation using the Finite Element Method in FEniCSx, and verify it via numerical convergence studies and mass balances. We identify high-order parameter interactions, specifically equilibrium collagen density and signalling dynamics, as the primary drivers of solver stability. A sensitivity analysis of nearly four million simulations reveals that isolated parameter variations predominantly govern the maximum wound contraction. entries.source_title: On the existence of mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors
entries.source_excerpt: Orthogonal arrays are foundational objects in combinatorial design theory and experimental design theory, with broad applications in computer science, coding theory, and cryptography. In this paper, we investigate the existence for mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors, and propose several new constructions based on incomplete orthogonal Latin squares, incomplete transversal designs, and $\Sigma$-resolvable transversal designs. As a result, we show that the necessary conditions for the existence of such mixed orthogonal arrays are also sufficient, except for a small number of known exceptions and nine unsettled cases.

entries.source_title: Hypercube Richardson varieties from magic words
entries.source_excerpt: Inspired by the recent preprint of Ellenberg, Libedinsky, Plaza, Simental, and Williamson, we study the geometry of Richardson varieties whose associated Bruhat intervals are boolean posets. We define magic words for a Bruhat interval and prove that for intervals with magic words the associated Richardson variety is a tower of $\mathbb{P}^1$-s. We also prove that the Bruhat intervals consisting of the dyadically well-distributed permutations all have magic words. This gives a new proof that they form a boolean poset.

entries.source_title: $a$-numbers of covers in characteristic two: semigroups and Riemann-Roch spaces
entries.source_excerpt: We compute the $a$-numbers of the Garcia-G\"uneri-Stichtenoth curves, the Beelen-Montanucci curves, and the Skabelund covers of Suzuki curves in characteristic two. The proofs use the identity $a(X)=\ell(\tfrac12\operatorname{div}(dt))$ and reduce the calculations to Riemann-Roch spaces on the base curves. We obtain transfer formulas for odd-degree radical covers, with one or several points at infinity, and evaluate them using Weierstrass semigroups and plane sections of the Hermitian curve. For the first two families we also give cyclic models over the projective line and relate the formulas to Elkin's rank formula. We then treat two classes of Artin-Schreier fibre products. A supersingular genus-six family has a-number $3$ at the zero parameter and $2$ elsewhere, although the genera and $a$-numbers of its quadratic quotients remain fixed. We determine its Ekedahl--Oort types as $(0,0,0,1,2,3)$ and $(0,1,1,2,3,4)$,

entries.source_title: Thinking Hard Above AI
entries.source_excerpt: There are many ways in which AI is generating uncertainty in mathematics. We are not sure how it will impact our jobs, it is raising questions about how it might affect academic training, and it is not clear how it might change the job search process and how we evaluate research. This is by no means an exhaustive list. In this post, I will focus two another related questions, which are: “Is there still any mathematics to be done? And will doing mathematics still be fun and interesting?” I believe that there is, and here I set out to explain why.

entries.source_title: Strict monotonicity of weighted inhomogeneous percolation thresholds under covering maps
entries.source_excerpt: We study Bernoulli bond percolation under weak covering maps for a class of weighted inhomogeneous product measures such that each edge $e$ carries a positive weight $w(e)$ and is open at intensity $\lambda\geq 0$ with probability $1-\exp(-\lambda w(e))$. We prove a strict monotonicity of the weighted critical intensities $\lambda_c$ in the covering compatibility setting under bounded degree, uniform ellipticity, tame fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. While for the weighted uniform connection thresholds $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$, we establish their strict monotonicity for non-injective weak covering maps under bounded degree, covering compatibility, uniform ellipticity, bounded-fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. Moreover, we verify a general-profile theorem on strict monotonicities of the two thresholds $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$ respectively under explicit compact-interval finite-energy, derivative bounds and aforementioned geometric conditions.

entries.source_title: The Compactness Theorem for Enriched Logic
entries.source_excerpt: The framework of enriched logic extends positive logic (also known as coherent logic) from sets to structures internal to a symmetric monoidal closed category $\mathcal{V}$. This framework was developed by Rosick\'y and the second-named author. The main novelty of this logic is that the arities of the function and relation symbols are now objects in $\mathcal{V}$. We prove the compactness theorem for this enriched logic. That is, a set of $\mathcal{V}$-enriched sequents has a model (internal to $\mathcal{V}$) if every finite subset has a model. To achieve this, we define ultraproducts of enriched structures and prove enriched versions of {\L}os' theorem. We then develop some model-theoretic applications. We start with an enriched version of the model-theoretic method of diagrams, establishing a correspondence between homomorphisms whose domain is some enriched structure $A$ and models of the set $\operatorname{Diag}(A)$ of all enriched atomic formulas with parameters from $A$ that are true in $A$. entries.title_zh: 富逻辑的紧致性定理

entries.source_title: Geometry-Aware Latent Representation Learning for Drag Coefficient Prediction of Irregular Particles
entries.source_excerpt: Predicting the drag coefficient $C_\mathrm{d}$ of irregular particles requires representing their complex three-dimensional geometry in a form suitable for predictive models. Empirical drag correlations and many data-driven models represent particle geometry through a small set of hand-crafted shape descriptors. Geometric differences omitted by these descriptors are unavailable to the predictor. We propose a variational autoencoder-multilayer perceptron (VAE-MLP) framework that learns a latent representation directly from voxelized particle geometry. Geometry reconstruction and drag coefficient prediction jointly guide the learning of this representation. We compare VAE-MLP with a descriptor-based MLP (Descriptor-MLP) and established empirical correlations using CFD data for synthetic particle geometries at Reynolds numbers of 10--200. When the evaluated geometric variations are represented in the training data, the two learned models achieve comparable accuracy for regular ellipsoids, while VAE-MLP yields lower errors for irregular particles. entries.source_title: On Niu's Conjecture for Two-Station Tandem Queues
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we prove a long standing conjecture in queueing theory made by Niu (1980): in a two-station tandem queueing system with constant service time (c) at station 1, the stationary average waiting time at station 2 is nonincreasing in c. Two very different proofs are provided: one for the general case and one for a special case in which the arrival process is Poisson and the service time at station 2 is exponential.
entries.title_zh: Niu 双站串联队列猜想的证明
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Niu 于 1980 年提出的双站串联队列猜想：若第一站服务时间为常数 c，则第二站稳态平均等待时间随 c 增大而不增。作者提供两种不同证明，一种处理一般情形，另一种针对到达过程为 Poisson 且第二站服务时间为指数分布的特例。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合排队论读者关注上游服务时长如何影响下游拥堵，以及经典单调性猜想的证明方法。

entries.source_title: "Deep lifts": Neural networks can generalize even with the dumbest optimizer
entries.source_excerpt: Given a labeled dataset $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$, consider drawing a parameter vector $\hat{\theta}$ uniformly at random from those that interpolate the data within a width-$W$ depth-$D$ ReLU architecture with continuous weights bounded within $[-M, M]$. We study the generalization properties of $\hat{\theta}$ in the case where the dataset can, in fact, be explained by a smaller $w$-by-$d$ ReLU network. Despite the obliviousness of the selection rule for $\hat{\theta}$, it adaptively generalizes at the rate $\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$, rather than being governed by the VC dimension of the full $W$-by-$D$ hypothesis class. The reason is due to a particular inductive bias in ReLU networks: the $w$-by-$d$ parameter *witnesses* an exponential volume of $W$-by-$D$ interpolating parameters, which dwarfs the volume of poorly generalizing parameters (conditioned on interpolation). We explicitly construct this set of near-equivalent $W$-by-$D$ parameters by a proof technique called *deep lifting*, and then tie the achievable volume to stability properties of the $w$-by-$d$ witness. Examples show that these techniques allow us to co
entries.title_zh: “深层提升”：即使优化器很笨，神经网络也能泛化
entries.summary_zh: 研究在可插值的宽深 ReLU 网络参数中均匀随机选取解时，若数据本可由更小网络解释，泛化误差仍可按小网络规模而非整个假设类 VC 维度控制。作者用 deep lifting 构造大量近似等价的大网络参数，说明小网络见证解对应的良好插值参数体积可能压过泛化差的解。

entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖数据可由较小 ReLU 网络解释及特定均匀抽样设定。
entries.paper_review: 理论主张清晰，速率中的维度因子和适用条件需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: MGE-PO: Entropy-Aware Credit Assignment for Mathematical Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: GRPO assigns the same group-relative advantage to equally rewarded responses within a question, leaving their generation uncertainty unused. We introduce MGE-PO, centered on four-quadrant (4Q) advantage shaping that combines verified correctness with rollout generation entropy. Correctness determines the sign of an additional correction, while entropy controls its magnitude: lower-entropy successes receive larger bonuses and higher-entropy failures receive larger penalties. An online entropy-based question curriculum supports this credit rule using cached rollout measurements. At the final checkpoint after eight training epochs on Qwen3-8B-Base, adding 4Q across three policy optimization settings yields absolute gains of 3.23-3.69% in six-benchmark macro avg@32 and 4.24-11.06% in macro pass@32. On Qwen2.5-7B-Base, the complete configuration raises four-benchmark macro avg@32 from 41.5% to 45.4%.
entries.title_zh: MGE-PO：用熵感知信用分配训练数学推理
entries.summary_zh: 论文指出 GRPO 会给同一题中获得相同奖励的回答相同组相对优势，未利用生成不确定性；MGE-PO 的四象限优势塑形把验证正确性与 rollout 熵结合，由正确性决定修正方向、熵决定幅度，并用在线熵课程挑选训练问题。作者报告在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上训练八轮后，加入该机制在六基准宏平均 avg@32 提升 3.23–3.69 个百分点、macro pass@32 提升 4.24–11.06 个百分点；Qwen2.5-7B-Base 的完整配置把四基准 avg@32 从 41.5% 提至 45.4%，均为论文设定下的实验结果。

entries.source_title: Space-filling curves and small-ball probabilities for the Kloosterman process
entries.source_excerpt: We construct explicitly a space-filling curve in the support of the limiting Kloosterman process, using the planar partial-sum curve of the Rudin--Shapiro sequence. The qualitative existence statement was previously attributed to J. Bober by Kowalski. The resulting curve is a closed, $1/2$-H\"older continuous loop whose image contains a specified triangle of area $1/128$. Its Fourier coefficients are purely imaginary and satisfy $|\widehat f(h)|\leq(2\pi|h|)^{-1}$ for $h\ne 0$. We also prove a uniform lower bound for small balls centred at closed $1/2$-H\"older curves with a fixed coefficient bound, of the form $\exp\{-C\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(2/\varepsilon)\}$. Known functional convergence then gives a quantitative lower bound for the limiting proportion of two-parameter Kloosterman paths approximating the constructed loop.
entries.title_zh: Kloosterman 过程的空间填充曲线与小球概率
entries.summary_zh: 论文用 Rudin–Shapiro 序列的平面部分和曲线，显式构造一条位于极限 Kloosterman 过程支撑集中的闭合 1/2-Hölder 曲线，其像包含面积为 1/128 的三角形；傅里叶系数为纯虚数，并满足给定的 1/|h| 上界。作者还证明，以满足固定系数界的闭合 1/2-Hölder 曲线为中心的小球概率有统一下界，量级为 exp(−C ε⁻² log²(2/ε))，再利用已知函数型收敛推导二参数 Kloosterman 路径逼近该曲线的比例下界。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合解析数论与随机过程读者，展示显式构造、概率估计和极限过程收敛如何结合。

entries.source_title: Optimized linear multistep methods for stiff problems
entries.source_excerpt: We design and test several new optimized linear multistep methods for stiff problems. Each method is A-stable, implicit, and second-order accurate. We focus on achieving the smallest possible error constant while also ensuring that stiff modes are damped. We recover some known optimal L-stable three- and four-step methods, and provide new and improved five-step methods. We also develop new methods that are not L-stable but provide a prescribed rate of damping in the infinitely stiff limit. Variable-step-size formulae are also provided for some of the new methods. Numerical tests demonstrate that the improved error constants lead to improved accuracy.
entries.title_zh: 刚性问题的优化线性多步法

entries.source_title: Poisson-Dirichlet statistics for the log-modulus of the Riemann zeta function on expanding intervals near the critical line
entries.source_excerpt: For $T > 0$ large, let $\tau$ be uniformly distributed on $[T,2T]$ and let $\sigma = \sigma(T)$ be a deterministic real part approaching $1/2$ from the right. For the Riemann zeta function $\zeta$, we study the Gibbs measure with density proportional to $|\zeta(\sigma + \mathrm{i}\tau + \mathrm{i} h)|^{\beta}$ on $I_{\theta} := [ - (\log{T})^{\theta},(\log{T})^{\theta}]$, for every $\theta > 0$ and $\beta > 0$. As $\beta$ increases, the Gibbs measure increasingly favors positions where $|\zeta|$ is large, providing a way to study the spatial organization of extreme values. Under explicit conditions on the rate at which $\sigma$ approaches the critical line, a phase transition is established at the critical inverse temperature $\beta_{c}(\theta) := 2\sqrt{1 + \theta}$. The limiting distribution of the correlation (or overlap) between the field values at two positions sampled from the Gibbs measure is concentrated at $0$ when $\beta \leq \beta_{c}(\theta)$, and assigns masses $\beta_{c}(\theta)/\beta$ and $1 - \beta_{c}(\theta)/\beta$ to $0$ and $1$, respectively, when $\beta > \beta_{c}(\theta)$. entries.source_title: FederatedBytes: Tokenizer-Free, Byte-Level Small Language Models for Efficient Multimodal Federated Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Federated Learning (FL) is a powerful machine learning framework that allows building a global model from the contributions of multiple, distributed clients, while ensuring the privacy of their local data. However, its heavy computational and communication overheads challenge its use for contemporary AI workloads such as natural language processing (NLP) and multimodal analysis. For this reason, this paper presents a novel small language model that leverages byte-level text and multimodal data processing, enhanced by a linear attention mechanism, to enable manageable Federated Learning of NLP and multimodal analysis tasks. The proposed model, nicknamed FederatedBytes, manages to process text and any other data types, including images, by treating its input as a mere sequence of bytes, while its lean linear attention mechanism allows abating the overall memory and computational footprint. To prove the effectiveness of the proposed model we have carried out an extensive performance evaluation on sentiment analysis tasks in multilingual and multimodal settings over the Multilingual Amazon Reviews and ScienceQA datasets. entries.source_title: Complete regular dessins: the nonmetacyclic case
entries.source_excerpt: We classify regular dessins on $K_{2^e,2^f}$ with nonmetacyclic colour-preserving automorphism group, retaining the two specified vertex rotations. We give nonredundant presentations and exact counts in both the abelian and nonabelian Frattini cases. For orientation- and colour-preserving isomorphisms, the number is $2^{2e-2}+16$ when $e=f\ge4$ and $3\cdot2^{2f-3}+16$ when $e>f\ge4$, with explicit counts for all smaller exponents. The construction uses a parity criterion in the abelian case and a uniquely determined odd quadratic root with two lifts in the nonabelian case. A dessin in the classification is reflexible exactly when its Frattini subgroup is abelian. All symmetric classes are circular. We determine every circular subfamily, including its face orders and genera; the circular count is $2^e+8$ on the diagonal and $2^{f-2}(2^{f-1}+1)+8$ off the diagonal for $e\ge f\ge4$.

entries.source_title: Asymptotic dimension of graphs excluding an induced or fat minor
entries.source_excerpt: Asymptotic dimension is a large-scale invariant of metric spaces that was introduced by Gromov (1993). A major open problem in coarse graph theory asks whether, for every fixed graph $H$, the class of graphs excluding $H$ as a fat minor has bounded asymptotic dimension. A weaker conjecture asserts the same conclusion for graphs excluding $H$ as an induced minor. We substantially expand the range of graphs $H$ for which these conjectures are known to hold. Specifically, we prove bounded asymptotic dimension for the following classes of graphs: graphs excluding a fixed planar graph as a fat minor; and graphs excluding a fixed string graph as an induced minor. All of our results also hold for the stronger notion of Assouad--Nagata dimension, a refinement of asymptotic dimension. These results have a number of applications, two of which we mention here. First they imply that an induced minor-closed class is $\chi$-bounded if and only if it does not contain some Burling graph. Second they imply that, in graph classes excluding a fixed planar graph as an induced minor, treewidth is polynomial in maximum degree.

entries.source_title: Causal Edit Serialization
entries.source_excerpt: Standard autoregressive language models generate text sequentially, but revision requires referring back to tokens in the input context or those already generated. Causal Edit Serialization (CES) is introduced as a framework for expressing such revisions within the same causal token stream. Special pointer tokens are paired with predicted source addresses, allowing insertion, deletion, replacement, copying and movement to be localized explicitly. A lightweight localization head and dual-index rotary position encoding support both address prediction and conditioning on previously emitted pointers, while retaining a standard causal attention mask. A pretraining procedure combines ordinary language modeling with serialized repairs derived from random corruptions, model-generated edits and repeated text. Across model scales and editing baselines, CES models demonstrate complete applied edits with modestly higher clean-text bits per byte than clean autoregressive models. Supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training provide a grammatical-error-correction proof of concept, producing more beneficial than harmful changes under reference
entries.title_zh: 因果编辑序列化
entries.summary_zh: CES 用专门指针 token 与源位置地址，把插入、删除、替换、复制和移动表示为自回归序列中的显式编辑操作。模型保留因果注意力，加入定位头和双索引 RoPE，并以随机损坏、模型生成修改及重复文本构造修复预训练数据；实验报告可执行编辑完整度提升但干净文本 bits-per-byte 略高，语法纠错微调提供概念验证。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合文本编辑模型和自回归解码研究者了解显式编辑动作表示。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把回看和局部修改纳入因果生成形式，编辑操作具有可定位性。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要显示语言建模代价略增，复杂编辑任务收益范围待评估。
entries.paper_review: 结构与训练方案清楚，质量—效率权衡和基线细节需阅读全文。
